clips.title: The story
paras: In the southern mountain wall of the Wetlands, Thelgen Rock’s caverns hold volatile Incendicite Ore. Venomous spiders infest the passages.

Thelgen Rock cuts deep into the mountains between the Wetlands and Loch Modan. Aggressive spiders fill its web-choked passages, and their venom makes every step dangerous. Miners and adventurers still brave the tunnels for the valuable Incendicite Ore embedded in the rock.
